title: The Silmarillion
author: J. R. R. Tolkien
summary: A collection of linked legends covering the creation of Tolkien's world, the first wars against its original dark lord, and the fall of the Elves' great kingdoms. It reads more like a mythology than a novel.
readIf: you want the ancient history behind Middle-earth and enjoy elevated, myth-like storytelling.
skipIf: you want conventional characters and dialogue, as it is dense with names and lacks a single hero.

pairings.reason: The accessible story that shows where all this history leads, with real scenes and characters.
Another fantasy in a mythic, restrained voice, with creation stories and the weight of names.
A very different, modern novel that also lives among gods and myths.
